target.development_target: the frozen R3 source-local descending midrank percentile
target.external_target: descending midrank percentile among strictly positive finite mapped protein values within each subject-particle NP-corona measurement batch
target.missingness: NA and zero are retained as non-rank-eligible; no imputation or non-detection inference

development_selection.fit_population: all 2,724 eligible frozen R3 development observations
development_selection.alpha_selection: nested leave-one-measurement-batch-out selection over alpha grid [0.01, 0.1, 1.0, 10.0, 100.0]
development_selection.outer_external_data_isolation: the 141-subject cohort is not used for feature selection, alpha selection or refitting

external_evaluation.laboratory_anchor: Seer, Inc. / Broad Institute of MIT and Harvard
external_evaluation.biological_unit: individual subject plasma sample identified by the first header token
external_evaluation.measurement_role: NP_CORONA only; depleted plasma columns excluded
external_evaluation.access_condition: paper-attached CC-BY-4.0 Supplementary Data 5; author-run exploratory cohort OOD; not a protected lockbox and not an independent evaluator

metrics.primary: subject-equal mean of within-subject batch Spearman correlations
metrics.constant_baseline_spearman: undefined by construction and reported as such
metrics.failure_reporting: all qualified batches and all 141 subject clusters remain in the denominator; undefined correlations are not silently dropped

negative_control.primary_endpoint: subject-equal mean Spearman on the held-out cohort

claim_boundary: This is an author-run exploratory biological-cohort OOD execution. It can quantify subject-level effective n and test transport to a paper-attached 141-subject cohort, but it is not a protected lockbox evaluation, independent evaluator receipt, no-author reproduction, new laboratory anchor or submission-readiness gate.
